The frontend is running at **http://localhost:5176**, with your branch up to date with `origin/main` (5 new commits, including the landing-page update from PR #16).

- **Port:** 5173–5175 were already in use, probably by dev servers in other worktrees, so Vite moved to 5176. That only matters for Google sign-in, because Supabase's redirect list has `localhost:5173` in it.
- **No `.env`:** there isn't one in this worktree or the main checkout, so the app runs on sample data with sign-in turned off. To sign in, copy `frontend/.env.example` to `frontend/.env` and fill in the two Supabase values.

- **AGENTS.md is out of date:** it describes `frontend/` as **Motus**, a tool for monitoring ALS at home through speech and typing. The app it runs is now **Addo Labs**, an ALS drug discovery tool. AGENTS.md says to fix this kind of mismatch right away, since every agent working in the repo reads that file.

## 4. Open questions — these need people, not agents

1. **Is this the product, or is Motus?** `main` currently ships a landing
   page and a longitudinal monitoring dashboard (speech/typing/handwriting
   vs personal baseline) *and* this discovery pipeline. They share a sidebar
   and nothing else. One demo, 90 seconds — a judge can follow one argument.
   **This is the most important open question in the repo.**
2. **What is it called?** `theme.ts`, `pipeline.ts` and `report.tsx` say
   **Addo Labs**. The landing page says **motus**. Pick one today.
3. **Does the old elimination funnel feed this?** The discovery module is
   self-contained and never reads `data/pipeline.json`. Either wire the
   graveyard in as the candidate pool (§1 — cheap, and it makes the two
   tracks one story) or retire the contract and say so.
4. **Answered → [`FUS_RESEARCH.md`](FUS_RESEARCH.md).** Was: **Can we cite the Sunnybrook FUS work accurately?** The claim rests on
   it. Get real citations for BBB opening in ALS or in neurodegeneration
   generally, and be precise about what has been shown in humans versus what
   is proposed. Mark anything unverified as unverified — a judge who knows
   the field will ask.
5. **Does FaceCheck still fit?** See `FACECHECK_SPEC.md` §7.

---

## 5. Risks worth naming before a judge does

- **Safety inverts too.** Opening the BBB for a drug also opens it for
  everything else circulating, and the drugs this unlocks were often not
  designed for CNS exposure. "It can now get in" is not "it is now safe
  once it's in." Having an answer here is a strength.
- **The ranking is the claim.** Cosine similarity in DRKG plus an LLM's
  reading is a hypothesis generator, not evidence. Frame the output as "what
  to investigate next", never as a recommendation.
======
# Decisions

Append-only, newest first. Three lines each: **what** we decided, **why**,
and what it **rules out**.

A decision here is settled — don't re-litigate it without new information.
If you reverse one, append the reversal; don't edit the old entry away.

---

## 2026-11-08 — Research sub-agents describe drugs, they don't name them

**What:** `agent/` sub-agents return target profiles (HGNC targets + desired
action, pathways, site, constraints, evidence) and never drug names; a
separate matcher (DRKG / embeddings) turns profiles into drugs.
**Why:** an LLM naming drugs pre-empts and biases the matching step, and
lands on the same famous handful every time. Profiles are also what Levi's
DRKG agents need as anchors.
**Rules out:** sub-agents with drug-level tools, or drug names in profile
text (`no_drugs.py` scrubs them). Drug-level tools stay for the matcher.

## 2026-11-07 — `frontend/` (Motus) is the only frontend

**What:** Deleted `app/` (Vite drug-funnel UI) and `web/` (a Next 16 rebuild
of the same). `frontend/` is the one frontend.
**Why:** Three frontends existed for one project because nobody checked
before starting. Two of them rendered a story we are no longer leading with.
**Rules out:** Reviving the lab-console funnel UI as-is. It's in git history
(`6c9a0f4` and parents) if any of it is wanted back.

## 2026-11-07 — The contract lives in `contract/`, not inside a frontend

**What:** Moved `contract.ts`, `contract.test.ts` and `validate.ts` out of
`app/src/lib/` into a standalone `contract/` package with one dependency
(zod).
**Why:** The Python owners run `npm run validate` to check their output. That
check must not die because a frontend was deleted, and it must not require
installing React to run.
**Rules out:** Putting schema code inside any app directory again.

content.text:
I've updated AGENTS.md, but not by just swapping in the new name. Issues #5 (which product) and #6 (which name) are both still open and marked as blockers, so writing "Addo Labs" in as settled would have made those calls for the team. The file now says what `main` ships today (Addo Labs, with Motus as its "Patient monitoring" view) and that the name and product are still open in #5 and #6. I left README.md alone because it's the Motus pitch, and replacing it is part of the #5 decision.

## Other decisions still open

All are unassigned. With 9:00 am as the real deadline, the first three set the pitch.

1. **#5 Product: discovery pipeline or Motus.** Every other decision depends on this one. The code has already leaned one way: PR #16 made the landing page say "ALS drug discovery optimization", the sidebar starts with pipeline stages 00–05, and Motus is now one page under Library. Someone needs to approve that (add a line to `docs/DECISIONS.md` and close the issue) or reverse it.
2. **#6 Name.** What the issue says is no longer true: the landing page now says "addo labs" too. Every file in `frontend/` says Addo Labs; only the README and older docs still say Motus. It just needs someone to approve it.
3. **#7 Jeremy and Levi are both building the same five agents.** The issue suggests the cheapest fix: Levi's Python agents produce the `PipelineEvent`s that Jeremy's UI currently fakes on a timer.
4. **#14 Demo mode.** I found no `.env` here or in your main checkout, so in practice the demo runs on sample data. Google sign-in would also need port 5173 free, and it's taken on your machine right now.
5. **#13 Knowledge graph.** There are three versions; pick one, or hide the "Knowledge graph" page.
6. **#15 Placeholder pages.** 15 pages show "coming soon". Decide which ones to hide before judges click on them.
7. **#12 FaceCheck as its own page or a tab.** If #5 goes to the discovery pipeline, this probably becomes "drop it".
8. **Does the drug funnel feed discovery, or do we retire the contract?** This is open question 3 in `docs/DISCOVERY_SPEC.md`, and **no issue tracks it**. The discovery pipeline never reads `data/pipeline.json`, so either connect it (the spec calls this cheap, and it ties the two tracks into one story) or say the contract is retired.
9. **Merging `Master-UI-Neo-Face-Integration`.** AGENTS.md says merging this branch is a decision. It's probably moot if #5 goes to the discovery pipeline.

**#8 isn't a decision, but it matters for the pitch.** "24 drugs never reached the brain" is wrong: it's 3 predicted BBB-negative, 8 that arrived and failed, and 21 undetermined. The safe number to quote is **1,593 of 3,791**.
